items.title: Deliver multi-tenant AI analytics at scale with AgentCore and Lake Formation
items.summary: Governed, multi-tenant data access is a key requirement for SaaS and B2C products that embed AI-powered analytics. This post shows how to combine Amazon Cognito and AWS Lake Formation on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to enforce row- and column-level data access for external users, with a minimal-privilege Lambda acting as a credential broker.
items.creator: Fortune Hui
